_schema_note: Phase R gate (task spec, ported from sarc-suite-one-pass's V4 gate): a citation may enter the paper only after it is verified by fetching its source page and recording url, title, first_author, year into this file. arxiv_id/doi are the machine-checkable tokens a future citation_check.py matches against paper text; verified_via records how/when the fetch was done (WebSearch snippets that quote the source's own indexed text, and/or a direct WebFetch of the source page, both dated). entry_type is one of article/inproceedings/incollection/misc; misc is used for arXiv preprints (no formal venue yet), technical reports/handbooks, and standards/webpages where no DOI-backed venue exists.
